sources.title: Proliferate Application README
sources.finding: Desktop AI IDE runs Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/Cursor/Grok in parallel. Tasks have isolated worktrees; subagents delegate scoped work. Build desktop from source with bundled local AnyHarness runtime; AGPL3.0.

sources.title: Proliferate Self-host production
sources.finding: Full control plane and browser app in same server image with Postgres/Caddy. Desktop points at own apiBaseUrl. Cloud workspaces use E2B runtime plus worker sidecar; old Supervisor launch helper not active. telemetryDisabled:true disables desktop telemetry; self-host server defaults anonymous.

sources.title: Proliferate Current subagent contract
sources.finding: Same-workspace children are normal durable sessions with own model/harness, cap8 per parent, exactly-once completion delivery and scoped Workspace MCP. Delegated children cannot delegate; target public API tier separate.

sources.title: Proliferate Current Agents pane
sources.finding: Pane lists durable parent/child roster and live status/history; user can send/queue messages, close/open/promote children. Remaining cowork/review UX is target, not assumed current.

sources.title: Proliferate Current workspaces
sources.finding: Local clone/worktree durable checkout; create/archive/restore/purge/checkpoint/mobility APIs. Separate worktrees per workspace; subagents share workspace. No automatic deletion of user checkout without request.

sources.title: Proliferate Current Git functions
sources.finding: Workspace-scoped status/diff/stage/unstage/commit/push/revert and hosting PR read model. Base-worktree review compares committed/staged/unstaged/untracked content.

sources.title: Proliferate Current agent authentication
sources.finding: Managed gateway, own API/provider config and Claude Max seat credential. Native login is a permanent supported fallback when configured/detected; managed auth optional. Launch fails if unconfigured.

sources.title: Proliferate Current workflow engine
sources.finding: Saved revisioned linear1-64-node workflow definitions freeze into invocation and execute ordinary agent/human-in-loop sessions. Current runtime statuses include awaiting_human/interrupted/completed. Schedule/webhook/Slack/API trigger intake remains target; generation1 managed delivery removed.

sources.title: Proliferate Current organizations
sources.finding: Owner/admin/member organization roles, invitations and tenant-scoped usage/limits. Membership status active/removed; billing separated from identity.

sources.title: Proliferate Current artifacts
sources.finding: Per-workspace .proliferate/artifacts.json manifest keeps titled markdown/HTML/SVG/React artifacts with atomic writes and path protection. Current entry points are gated to Cowork workspaces; run/session attribution and evidence capture are greenfield.

sources.title: Proliferate Application license
sources.finding: GNU Affero GPL version3 covers application repository.

sources.title: Proliferate Desktop telemetry implementation
sources.finding: Startup reads app config telemetry_disabled; explicit build/config disable returns Disabled before hosted/self-managed mode. This implements deployment doc telemetryDisabled control.

sources.title: Proliferate current homepage
sources.finding: Homepage currently says small San Francisco team working on people/AGI collaboration, with more coming soon; former product docs/pricing absent.

sources.title: Proliferate GitHub releases
sources.finding: desktop-v0.1.36 (2026-05-28) publishes macOS aarch64 and x64 DMG/app bundles. Latest server-v0.4.29 and runtime-v0.4.29 releases are dated 2026-08-27; proliferate-v0.4.29 has no assets.

sources.title: Proliferate Cloud workspace spec
sources.locator: Status; Cloud surfaces culled on the desktop client (PRO-10), backend dormant
sources.finding: Target spec. Every desktop cloud-workspace surface is removed or host-gated to web; backend provisioning is dormant and web keeps cloud affordances behind a host capability. Conflicts with the deploy guide describing current E2B cloud materialization.

sources.title: Proliferate Desktop desktop-v0.1.36 release assets
sources.locator: GitHub release desktop-v0.1.36 (2026-05-28, commit 4c0affd): Proliferate_0.1.36_aarch64.dmg, Proliferate_0.1.36_x64.dmg, matching .app.tar.gz and .sig files
sources.finding: The latest desktop release publishes free macOS DMG and app bundles for Apple Silicon and Intel only. It has no Windows or Linux desktop assets.

sources.title: Proliferate desktop release matrix
sources.finding: The desktop-host spec says the desktop release matrix is macOS-only and treats Windows/Linux desktop builds as a possible future addition.

sources.title: Proliferate Windows desktop beta lane
sources.finding: Windows desktop builds are an opt-in beta leg that the automatic release paths leave off, are unsigned and not release-blocking. The guide says no agent session can start on a Windows build today because there is no Windows agent seed or launcher.

sources.title: Proliferate AnyHarness CLI
sources.finding: The product-owned anyharness binary has a command-line interface with serve, install-agents, print-openapi and catalog-probe subcommands. Release runtime-v0.4.29 ships it for macOS, Linux and Windows.

sources.title: Proliferate runtime PR routes (desktop-v0.1.36)
sources.finding: At the desktop-v0.1.36 release commit, the bundled runtime exposes workspace-scoped GitHub CLI-backed routes to read the current pull request and to create a pull request.

sources.title: Proliferate gh pr create adapter (desktop-v0.1.36)
sources.finding: create_pr runs gh pr create with title, body and base branch, and adds --draft when requested. It requires the user's installed and authenticated GitHub CLI.

sources.title: Proliferate desktop publish workflow (desktop-v0.1.36)
sources.finding: The desktop publish flow builds a stage, commit, push and create_pull_request step sequence for a workspace.

sources.title: Proliferate SSO removal
sources.finding: The accounts spec says SSO was deleted end to end on 2026-08-25 (PR #2218): no SSO settings, tables, routes or client surfaces remain.
